6. Cash Flow and Financial Requirements
Calvion Digital LLC reported closing cash of AED 1,850,000 as at 30 June 2026, against a
minimum operating cash requirement of AED 2,500,000, resulting in a cash shortfall of AED
650,000.
Customer payments totaling AED 425,000 were received on 10 July 2026.
The company paid AED 185,000 for infrastructure maintenance on 25 June 2026, earlier than
originally budgeted.
